name: abugida-media-kit
description: Accessible media player, tagged documents, and career gateway for Savanna LMS and Ethiopian platforms

scripts.build: npm run --workspace=packages/lesson-schema build && npm run --workspace=packages/media-kit build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('packages/media-kit/dist-bundle', 'apps/demo/public/dist', {recursive:true}); fs.mkdirSync('module', {recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('packages/media-kit/dist-bundle/a11y-media-kit.umd.js', 'module/db-player.js'); fs.mkdirSync('savanna/assets/js', {recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('packages/media-kit/dist-bundle/a11y-media-kit.umd.js', 'savanna/assets/js/db-player.js');" && npm run --workspace=apps/demo build
scripts.typecheck: npm run --workspace=packages/lesson-schema typecheck && npm run --workspace=packages/media-kit typecheck && npm run --workspace=apps/demo typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:a11y && npm run test:integration
